verdict.rationale: PayPal's evidence shows transaction-level reporting and dispute/refund tooling (get_merchant_insights, list_transaction, dispute and refund APIs) that could feed reconciliation workflows, but there is no documented settlement report or bank-deposit-matching feature tying fees, refunds, and chargebacks together. missing for 10: dedicated settlement/reconciliation report, bank deposit matching, itemized fee breakdown tied to payouts.
